title: 19-BCV-008 - Multi-level storage racking systems
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE))

facts.text: The variance allows a multi-level storage-racking system to be considered a special and unusual structure under Sentence 3.2.2.2.(1), rather than treating its access levels as ordinary individual storeys/mezzanines.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-008 PDF, p. 1, Purpose and Discussion; p. 2, Variance

facts.text: A fire safety plan is to be submitted with the building permit application, and the system must be arranged to prevent access by people other than employees.
Conditions include Part 4 design of structural/supporting elements, guarded access levels, specified open-area rules, and required signage.
The document specifies automatic sprinkler protection under platforms/access levels and detailed egress, travel-distance, and occupant-load controls.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
